title: jagged tunisian almonds tagine
description:
a briny, crisp tunisian dish featuring almonds and shio-cure, perfect for post-workout.
this diabetic-friendly tagine is a refreshing twist on traditional tunisian cuisine.
instructions: heat the olive oil in a large saucepan over medium heat.
add the chopped almonds and cook until fragrant, about 2 minutes.
add the shio-cure, fennel, and red onion, and cook until the vegetables are tender, about 5 minutes.
add the lemon juice, salt, and black pepper, and stir to combine.
reduce heat to low and simmer for 10 minutes.
stir in the chopped parsley and fresh mint.
serve warm, garnished with additional parsley and mint if desired.
let cool slightly before refrigerating or freezing for later use.
